verse.verse_1: By the winds sent forth with beneficence.
verse.verse_5: And those winds that bring down the remembrance.
verse.verse_6: By way of excuse or warning.
verse.verse_7: Verily that which ye are promised is about to befall.
verse.verse_9: And when the heaven is cloven asunder.
verse.verse_10: And when the mountains are carried away by wind.
verse.verse_11: And when the apostles are collected at the appointed time,
verse.verse_12: For what day is it timed?
verse.verse_14: And what knowest thou what the Day of Decision is?
verse.verse_15: Woe on that day Unto the beliers
verse.verse_17: Thereafter We shall cause to follow them the latter ones.
verse.verse_18: In this wise We do with the culprits.
verse.verse_19: Woe on that day Unto the beliers!
verse.verse_20: Created We you not of water despicable,
verse.verse_21: Which We placed in a depository safe.
verse.verse_23: So We decreed. How excellent are We as decreers!
verse.verse_24: Woe on that day Unto the beliers!
verse.verse_25: Have We not made the earth a receptacle.
verse.verse_26: Both for the living and the dead,
verse.verse_27: And have placed therein firm and tall mountains and given you to drink of water fresh
verse.verse_28: Woe on that day Unto the beliers!
verse.verse_29: 'Depart Unto that which ye were wont to belie.
verse.verse_30: Depart Unto the shadow three branched:
verse.verse_31: Neither shading nor availing against the flame.
verse.verse_32: Verily it shall cast forth sparks like Unto a castle.
verse.verse_33: As though they were camels yellow tawny.
verse.verse_34: Woe on that day Unto the beliers!
verse.verse_35: This is a Day whereon they shall not be able to speak.
verse.verse_36: Nor shall they be permitted so that they might excuse themselves.
verse.verse_37: Woe on that day Unto the beliers!
verse.verse_38: This is the Day of Decision, We have assembled both ye and the ancients.
verse.verse_39: If now ye have any craft, try that craft upon Me.
verse.verse_40: Woe on the day Unto the beliers!
verse.verse_41: Verily the God-fearing shall be amid shades and springs,
verse.verse_42: And fruits such as they shall desire.
verse.verse_43: 'Eat and drink with relish that which ye have been working.
verse.verse_44: Verily We! in this wise We recompense the well-doers.
verse.verse_45: Woe on that day Unto the beliers!
verse.verse_46: 'Eat and enjoy a little; verily ye are culprits.
verse.verse_47: Woe on that day Unto the beliers!
verse.verse_48: And when it is said Unto them: 'bow down, they bow not down.
verse.verse_49: Woe on that day Unto the beliers!
verse.verse_50: In what discourse, then, after it, will they believe?
